Visit during weekdays or off-peak hours to avoid potential noise from music
Don't miss out on trying their seasonal specials which showcase fresh ingredients

reviews.reviewText: Excellent excellent food. Everything I tasted was phenomenal. The location is great. It was a little bit noisy with the music but other than that I highly recommend eating here and spending some time enjoying the vibe. A salad was to die for the fish was melt in your mouth and I had a squid that was just too good to be true.
If you appreciate fine dining Italian cuisine, then find your way to this gem. The plates are thoughtful, full of flavor. The desserts decadent. Go ahead and indulge.

Lovely restaurant with quite interesting food. Octopus appetizer was excellent, and a lot of flavors went very well together. For the main, I got the duck, with beet tagliatelle. Duck itself was good, but tagliatelle was not pasta but simply shaved beets, which were a bit too hard. Service is excellent, if I lived in Mexico city I'd definitely give it another try and go for an actual pasta there.

Found this place on Michelin Guide as bib gourmand. It is WRONG! This place must have a star and I sincerely wish they got it ASAP. Great and cozy atmosphere, doesn’t matter where you are sitting outside or in. Menu is not very long, however with three specials you definitely have a choice. Food arrives promptly, beautifully arranged and super tasty! Most of the pastas - they all made in house - you can get half size. That our only mistake, we didn’t do it. If we ever back in Mexico City we’ll be back! First thing after arrival. And second! P.S. Sorry, cut my review short! My wife ordered canoly and I must tell you that was even better than all we ate before!

Came here with two friends and we each had the tasting menu, adding a few extra dishes along with a bottle of wine and some cocktails. The service was outstanding, with thoughtful touches (I especially loved the wooden blocks for the cutlery). The wine selection was excellent and I’d highly recommend it. Overall, a fantastic experience.

restaurants.name: Tetetlán
restaurants.description: Innovative cuisine served in a stylish all-day outfit with exposed-stone walls & a glass floor.
restaurants.generatedDescription: Tetetlán is a unique cultural complex located in the Jardines del Pedregal neighborhood of Mexico City. It offers a blend of innovative cuisine, local markets, and community-focused stores, all promoting traditional Mexican heritage and crafts. The complex is housed in an old stable block next to the restored house of renowned architect Luis Barragan. Visitors can explore stylish restaurants serving creative dishes made with locally sourced organic ingredients.
restaurants.address: Av. de Las Fuentes 180 - B, Jardines del Pedregal, Álvaro Obregón, 01900 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico
restaurants.reviewsSummary: Tetetlán is a stunning and unique restaurant located in Jardines del Pedregal, Mexico City. Reviewers praise the breathtaking environment with features like a glass floor above lava rocks, bookstore-like atmosphere, and beautiful architecture. While some mention minor service issues and mixed reviews on food quality, the overall experience is highly recommended for its aesthetic design, ambiance, delicious coffee and juices, customizable chilaquiles, and standout dishes like ceviche and plantain with Mole.
reasonsToVisit: Experience dining in a visually striking setting with a glass floor overlooking lava rocks
Explore different levels of the place including shops selling locally made art and handicrafts
Enjoy creative Mesoamerican dishes using organic ingredients at the restaurant
Visit La Casa Pedregal next door designed by renowned architect Luis Barragán
tips: Try ordering items other than tacos for potentially better food experiences
Ask about seasonal menu offerings for unique culinary experiences
Check out the gift shop to purchase locally made art and handicrafts
Reserve ahead of time due to high demand; consider valet parking if needed
Visit Tetetlán as part of exploring Jardines del Pedregal neighborhood for a full cultural experience

reviews.reviewText: I was extremely pleased with our visit at Tetelán!! The atmosphere is beautiful. When you walk in, you are greeted with a gift shop and a record store above to the left. The portion sizes are pretty large as well. I got the chapulín taco and I do not regret it. Staff was very friendly and attentive. I will definitely come back here when visiting again.

This is my third time going to Tetetlan. We always make sure to make it a trip when we go to CDMX San Jerónimo. We went for dinner and the food was good, not great like other places I’ve been to but still good. The salsas were not bad but they could be more flavorful. Tlayudas were delicious. We ordered the plátano macho with molé, the mole was very spicy but the combination was delicious. The huitlacoche with 4 different sauces. For our entree we got the molcajete with cactus, arrachera and shrimp, very skimpy on the shrimp, it only came with three and way too much cheese. Blue corn tortillas were delicious. We also got the vegan horchata, very good and not too sweet and the charcoal activated water with a hint of lime juice, that was my favorite. We love the dessert push cart, its a beautiful sight! We got the chocolate crepe cake and it was very good. The vibes are always great, the atmosphere is always beautiful, the music selection always top notch. Book selection also top notch, this place is so beautiful. Very well thought out place, the decor, the shop with mexican artisan’s pottery, jewelry, clothing etc, just cant be beat. Looking forward to going back!

An incredible hidden gem in an area that is usually residential. Everything was great, the service, the food, the ambience and the FLOOR! We took so many pictures everywhere in the restaurant. The top part is a nice bar to chill and listen to music, the middle part sells amazing artisan ice cream and many Mexican souvenirs. They even have a luxury store. The kitchen is open so you can see the chefs cooking the food you're about to enjoy. Overall, a great experience!

Ohh em gee! The food and service were superb. Eduardo was an incredible server. He was knowledgeable, friendly, and attentive. He went above and beyond to make our visit feel truly special. I highly recommend this place for a unique experience and outstanding food. We will definitely be coming back, all thanks to Eduardo’s exceptional service.

How I discovered this spot is a testament to how Google Maps can work if you are prepared to explore it and click things unthinkingly. Nestled in a super swanky part of town, this shop, library, co-working space, and café offers an exceptionally unique experience in an area most tourists don't explore. While planning a visit to the UNAM Botanical Garden, we wanted to get an early start, but still wanted a hearty breakfast before spending the morning hiking and birdwatching. As I explored the area, I tapped into this café, and I am so glad I did. The space is clearly a repurposed space that now affords the library and café super-tall ceilings, glass skylights, and views of the ancient stones beneath the floor. There is nothing about this space that isn't a creative way to showcase yet another dynamic side of the endeavor. We came early as it's open every day at 7 am, and started with a German coffee experience that looks like half science experiment and half art class. My wife needed pancakes, and I tried their salmon toast. The pancakes were tall and fluffy, served with fruit and a caramel sauce. My salmon was more cured than "smoked" and came with a caper tapenade. The bread was delicious, and I enjoyed trying different salsas on my breakfast. There was so much to try on the menu, so we will have to come back. Some of the dishes coming out of the kitchen looked amazing, so I did have a little food envy. Once breakfast was over, we decided to explore the rest of the space by doing a little bit of gift shopping upstairs and checking out the massive record collection, which included a host of famous international artists, as well as records we pressed for the Mexican market. Many even have different album covers entirely. So cool. This fantastic destination is about 30 minutes outside of town from where we were staying in Roma, so I recommend planning to tour this part of CDMX if you are going to start your morning here. We loved it and plan on coming back the next time we are in town.
